name: Monster Slayer
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Monster Slayer
💥 Fight giant monsters, unlock epic swords, and become the ultimate slayer

⚔️ How to Play:
- Click to gain power and earn coins!
- Battle beasts and bosses for bigger rewards.
- Hatch powerful pets to boost your abilities.
- Unlock legendary swords and rare enchantments
- Explore new worlds and hidden realms!


Join a massive community of monster slayers!

👊 Prove your might and rise to the top!
💎 Like and favorite for more update
